beats.caption: You asked. It answered. Who taught it?
beats.narration: You type a question and get an answer in your tone. Nobody typed that answer in. Five stages did.

beats.caption: A student who read the whole library first
beats.narration: Picture a student who read the whole library before learning any manners. That is a chat model. Reading is first. Manners come later.

beats.caption: Stage 1: text becomes tokens
beats.narration: Stage one. Text is collected, cleaned, and cut into tokens, small word pieces. The post argues quality matters more than sheer volume.

beats.caption: Stage 2: guess the next word, a trillion times
beats.narration: Stage two is pretraining. The only job is guessing the next token, over and over, across trillions of tokens.

beats.caption: The result: brilliant autocomplete, not an assistant
beats.narration: What comes out is a base model. Brilliant autocomplete. Ask it a question and it may just continue your sentence.

beats.caption: Stage 3: show it how to behave
beats.narration: Stage three. Supervised fine-tuning. Thousands of worked examples of prompts and good responses teach it the shape of being helpful.

beats.caption: Stage 4: teach a coach what better means
beats.narration: Stage four. People rank several answers. A separate model, the reward model, learns to predict those rankings. Now it can score millions.

beats.caption: Stage 5: practice against the coach
beats.narration: Stage five. Generate, score with the reward model, update, repeat. This loop is what people mean by reinforcement learning from human feedback.

beats.caption: Likely words are not true words
beats.narration: It was optimized to produce likely text, not true text. When it lacks the facts, it still writes fluently. Fluency is not evidence.

beats.caption: Data quality often beats data volume
beats.narration: The post's recurring lesson: better data beats more data at every stage.

beats.caption: Five stages, one pipeline
beats.narration: Tokens. Pretraining. Fine-tuning. A reward model. Practice. Five stages, one pipeline.

beats.caption: Read the article, build a tiny one
beats.narration: The realistic next step is building a tiny stage-two model yourself. The article links where to start.
